Bucket.description:
Bucket size for the time series. Pre-aggregated tables back the
sub-hourly resolutions. Coarser buckets (`1d`, `1w`) are rejected on
intraday endpoints.
Bucket.name: bucket

DateQuery.description:
Trading date the request targets, in `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to the
current trading date (the most recent session that has settled
enough data to be queryable). Past dates fall through to the daily
rollup tables.
DateQuery.name: date

EndTime.description: Upper bound of the window (RFC 3339 or Unix seconds).
EndTime.name: end_time

OptionSymbol.description:
OPRA option symbol in URL-safe form:
`{ticker}__{YYMMDD}{C|P}{strike×1000, 8 digits}` — the ticker and the
15-character contract block are joined by a **double underscore**
(`__`). For example, an AAPL $250 call expiring 2026-01-17 is
`AAPL__260117C00250000`. (A space-padded 21-char OCC form such as
`AAPL  260117C00250000` is also accepted on some endpoints, but the
`__` form is canonical and works across all contract routes.)
OptionSymbol.name: symbol

StartTime.description:
Lower bound of the window. Accepts RFC 3339
(`2026-05-27T13:30:00Z`) or Unix seconds.
StartTime.name: start_time

Timeframe.description:
Trailing window label for the request. Supported values:
`5m`, `15m`, `1h`, `4h`, `1d`.
Timeframe.name: timeframe

error.message: API access has been suspended for this account. Contact support.
Access to this API has been disallowed

Forbidden.description: Unknown, revoked or expired API key (the gateway's `forbidden`), the account's API access is suspended (`account_suspended`) or blocked (`account_blocked`). Not retryable.

error.message: The request took too long and was not completed. It was not charged; narrow the request or retry.

GatewayTimeout.description: The request did not complete within 25 seconds. Not charged; narrow the window or retry.

error.message: Out of credits. Top up to continue making requests.

InsufficientCredits.description: The account's shared Skylit credit balance is lower than this route's cost. Top up to continue. Carries `X-Credits-Remaining: 0`.

X-Credits-Remaining.description: Remaining credit balance (0 on this response).

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error (`INTERNAL_ERROR`, `DATABASE_ERROR`). Not charged; safe to retry with exponential backoff.

error.message: No trades found for AAPL on 2026-05-27 with timeframe 1d

NotFound.description: Unknown ticker or contract (`SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND`), or no data for the requested window. Not charged.

RateLimited.description: The key exceeded its requests-per-minute limit (`X-RateLimit-Limit`). No `Retry-After` is sent; wait until `X-RateLimit-Reset`, then retry.

error.message: Could not verify credit balance. Please retry.
Live feed is degraded; please retry in a few seconds.

Unavailable.description: Underlying data source temporarily unavailable, the credit balance could not be verified (`credit_check_failed`), or the API is paused for maintenance (`api_paused`, with a `Retry-After` header and a `retry_after` field in seconds). Not charged; safe to retry.

breadthPct.description: Share (0–100) of tickers classified as advancing.

byTimeframe.description:
Map keyed by timeframe id (`1h`, `4h`, `1d`, `7d`, `30d`,
`90d`, …). Only the requested timeframes appear; missing
entries indicate the underlying query failed for that horizon.

bullPct.description: Share (0–100) of volume classified as bullish.

callBullPct.description: Bullish share within calls only (high = aggressive call buying).

putBullPct.description: Bullish share within puts only (high = put selling = contrarian bullish).

callIv.description: Last call-side IV in the bucket. May be null when no quotes are available.

aggressionRatio.description: (askTrades + bidTrades) / midTrades — capped at 999 when midTrades = 0.

askRatio.description: Share (0–1) of trades at or above ask.

atmConcentration.description: Share (0–1) of volume in ATM strikes (±3% moneyness).

bidRatio.description: Share (0–1) of trades at or below bid.

callPutRatio.description: Call premium / put premium (capped at 999 when puts = 0). `null` when `option_type` filters out one side, so the ratio is undefined.

midRatio.description: Share (0–1) of trades at mid (or with no BBO).

otmCallConcentration.description: Share (0–1) of call volume in OTM strikes.

otmPutConcentration.description: Share (0–1) of put volume in OTM strikes.

callOiTotal.description: Sum of `callOi` over the returned strikes.

maxPain.description:
Strike at which the total intrinsic value owed to option holders
(Σ callOi·max(0, S−K) + putOi·max(0, K−S)) is smallest, computed
over the returned strikes. OI is each contract's latest reported
value among the day's trades, so contracts that did not trade are
absent; `min_volume` narrows it further. `null` when no OI is
reported.

putOiTotal.description: Sum of `putOi` over the returned strikes.

ClusterInfo.description:
Present when `includeClusters=true` and the trade is part of a sweep,
condor, or other multi-leg cluster.

ContractChartBar.description: One bucketed bar in the contract-chart response.

ContractRvolResponse.description:
With `format=full` (the default) the response carries `bars`; with
`format=summary` `bars` is omitted and only `stats` is returned.

DarkPoolPrint.description: One off-exchange (TRF) print. Carries no side / BBO / greeks.

pctAvgVol.description:
Print size as a percent of the underlying's average daily volume
(`size ÷ ADV × 100`, e.g. `15.53` = 15.53% of a normal day's
consolidated volume). ADV is a consolidated average daily volume,
refreshed daily. Omitted when no ADV is available for the ticker
(recent IPO, alternate-class symbol, or ADV not yet loaded).

DarkPoolTopPrint.description: One of the largest individual dark-pool prints over the window.

count.description: Number of prints returned in this page.

hasMore.description:
`true` when the page is full (`count == limit`), so more rows
may exist. Offset-based heuristic, not an exact total.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable error code. Common values:
`INVALID_PARAMETER`, `MISSING_PARAMETER`, `UNAUTHORIZED`,
`FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_FOUND`, `NO_DATA`, `SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND`,
`RATE_LIMITED`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `UNAVAILABLE`,
`GATEWAY_TIMEOUT`, `DATABASE_ERROR`, plus the lowercase codes
`insufficient_credits`, `account_suspended`,
`credit_check_failed`, `account_blocked`, `api_paused`, and
the gateway's `unauthorized`, `forbidden` and `rate_limited`.

docs_url.description: Link to this code's entry on the public errors page. Optional; may be absent (for example on errors from the gateway).

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Wording may evolve; key off `code`.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying; sent only with `api_paused` (the same value is in the `Retry-After` header).

FlowTradeItem.description:
One options trade with full Skylit scoring + context. A subset of
the most-relevant fields is documented inline; the response may add
new fields under additive evolution rules.

exchangeCount.description: Number of distinct OPRA exchanges that filled the order.

liquidityGrade.description:
Liquidity of the contract from its bid/ask spread as a percent of
mid: `HIGH` (under 2%), `MEDIUM` (2–5%), `LOW` (5% or wider).

relativePremium.description: Premium relative to the contract's average premium.

convictionMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to base direction to yield `flowScore`.

premiumRvol.description: Premium relative to the trailing 20-day baseline at this time of day.

isGap.description: True when this bucket spans a session/holiday gap and contains no real trades.

manualNcp.description: NCP variant computed without the script-trade exclusion.

ncp.description: Net Call Premium for the bucket (call buying minus call selling).

npp.description: Net Put Premium for the bucket.

spyPrice.description: SPY trade price at the bucket boundary, for overlay charts.

requestId.description: Short opaque ID for log correlation.

timestamp.description: Server-side timestamp the response was generated at.

baseline.description: Null when there are insufficient baseline days available.

firZscore5m.description: Z-score of the current 5-minute FIR vs baseline.

premiumZscore5m.description: Z-score of the current 5-minute premium vs baseline.

trend.description:
`ACCELERATING_BULLISH` / `ACCELERATING_BEARISH` when the 5-minute
FIR is strong, pulling away from the 1-hour window and at least
1.5σ from baseline; `BULLISH` / `BEARISH` for sustained
directional flow; otherwise `NEUTRAL`.

weightedPremium.description: Premium scaled by a moneyness weight (deeper OTM = higher multiplier).

OptionTradeRow.description:
Enriched single-trade row served by the trades endpoints. Most
fields are always present; `*Pct`, `nextIv`, `agg*`, `strategy*`,
and `earnings*` are optional.

ingestionTimestamp.description: Server ingest time in milliseconds since epoch.

mlSibling.description: True when this leg was included via spread association rather than its own filter match.

premiumPercentile.description: Bucketed premium percentile band (0 = below P50, 99 = P99+).

prevCloseAge.description: Trading days back the `prevClose` came from (0 = yesterday).

side.description:
Granular execution-side label — `BB` (below bid), `B` (bid),
`AB` (above bid), `M` (mid), `BA` (below ask), `A` (ask),
`AA` (above ask), or `N` (no BBO).

tsEvent.description: Trade event timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

avgDaysCount.description: Number of days actually used in the baseline.

fir.description: Flow Imbalance Ratio: (bullish − bearish) / total directional × 100

etf.description: Sector ETF symbol when resolvable (e.g. `XLK` for Technology).

similarityScore.description: 0..1; higher = more similar to today's flow profile.

positionInSpread.description:
Discrete bucket label inferred from the canonical side code
(`A`/`AA`/`BA` → ask-side, `B`/`BB`/`AB` → bid-side, `M` → mid,
`N` or no BBO → `unknown`).

askPct.description: Share of premium executed at-or-above ask (aggressive buying).

bidPct.description: Share of premium executed at-or-below bid (aggressive selling).

maxPain.description: Strike at which total option-holder payout would be minimized.

topStrike.description: Strike with the highest combined call+put premium.

top3StrikesShare.description: Share (0–1) of the window's premium concentrated in the top 3 strikes.

exchanges.description: Distinct OPRA exchange codes that filled the sweep.

executionTimeMs.description: Milliseconds between first and last leg of the sweep.

flowScore.description: Directional Flow Score for the aggregated sweep.

returnedCount.description: Sweeps included in the `sweeps` array (capped by `limit`).

sdf.description: Sweep Dominance Factor (-100..+100) over the full day.

totalSweeps.description: Estimated total logical sweeps for the day (population, not just `returnedCount`).

totalPremium.description: Total premium (USD) across all option trades on the day.

sweepAlignment.description: True when VWF and SDF agree in direction.

timeDecayApplied.description: Present only when time decay was applied.

pctOfSector.description: Share of the sector's net premium (0–100).

description.description: One-sentence human-readable explanation of the trade.

intent.description:
Intent classification (e.g. `opening_long_call`, `closing_short_put`,
`aggressive_call_buy`, `passive_call_sell`). Returned as a stable
`snake_case` token; new values may be added as classification
improves.

description.description: Human-readable interpretation of the short→long horizon contour.

UnderlyingChartBar.description:
One bucketed bar in the underlying-chart response. Each bar covers
`[timestamp, timestampEnd)` in Unix UTC seconds.

avgPremium.description: 30D baseline premium for this time-of-day slot.

avgVolume.description: 30D baseline volume for this time-of-day slot. Omitted when insufficient history.

chainAskPct.description: % of bucket volume executed at/above the ask.

chainBidPct.description: % of bucket volume executed at/below the bid.

timestamp.description: Bucket start, Unix seconds (returned as a string for JS-precision safety).

UnderlyingRvolResponse.description:
With `format=full` (the default) the response carries `bars`; with
`format=summary` `bars` is omitted and only `stats`, `callRvol` and
`putRvol` are returned.

lastPrice.description: Last traded underlying stock price on `date`.

ratio.description: Vol/OI ratio for the bucket (0 when OI is zero).

accumulationScore.description: Composite accumulation score weighted by volume + OTM share.

newPositionEstimatePct.description: Estimated share of volume that represents new positions.

premiumVsAvg.description: Today's premium as a multiple of the historical average (1.0 = at average).

composite.description: Composite roll-up of VWF/SDF/FIR for the window.

bias.description:
Label for the window's composite score: `STRONG_BULLISH` (≥ 60),
`BULLISH` (≥ 20), `NEUTRAL` (between -20 and 20), `BEARISH`
(≤ -20), `STRONG_BEARISH` (≤ -60).

signalStrength.description:
`strong` / `moderate` need at least 100 trades in the window;
`neutral` means the composite score is too small to call.

bearerApiKey.description:
Skylit API key in the `Authorization` header
(`Authorization: Bearer <key>`). The bare key without `Bearer ` is
also accepted; `X-API-Key` is not.

info.description:
Flowseeker exposes Skylit's real-time options-flow scoring stack — Flow
Score, FlowBonus, VWF/SDF/FIR aggregates, sector rotation, and market
breadth — as a versioned public HTTP API. Data is sourced from the full
OPRA options feed with sub-second freshness during market hours.

**Base URL.** `https://api.skylit.ai` serves this API and the core
(Heatseeker) API with one key. `https://flow-api.skylit.ai` is a
permanent alias for the same API: same keys, limits and credits. This
spec is also served at `https://api.skylit.ai/v1/flow/openapi.json`.

**Authentication.** Send your Skylit API key as a bearer token:

    Authorization: Bearer <key>

The gateway also accepts the bare key in the `Authorization` header
without the `Bearer ` prefix. `X-API-Key` and query-string keys are not
accepted (`401`). A request without an `Authorization` header gets `401`;
an unknown, revoked or expired key gets `403`.

**Rate limits.** Each key has a requests-per-minute limit set by the
account's plan (Pro, Protégé and Quant: 120 per key; invite: 60 per key),
counted across every Skylit API host. `GET https://api.skylit.ai/v1/account`
returns it as `limits.requestsPerMinute`; read it instead of hard-coding a
number. Over it the gateway answers `429` `rate_limited`. Responses carry
`X-RateLimit-Limit` (the key's limit), `X-RateLimit-Remaining` (requests
left in the current window) and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (Unix time, in
seconds, when the window resets). The gateway's `429` has no `Retry-After`: wait until
`X-RateLimit-Reset`. `429`s from the API itself (concurrency and stream
limits) carry `Retry-After`.

**Credits & billing.** Every `/v1/*` data request debits a fixed number of
**credits** from your account's shared Skylit balance (the same balance used
across all Skylit public APIs). Each chargeable response carries
`X-Credits-Remaining: <balance>`. Credits are charged before the request
is served and refunded when it fails (any `4xx` or `5xx`). Cost is priced
by server-side work and data volume returned:

| Tier | Credits | Routes |
|------|--------:|--------|
| Light | 1 | single-key reads, ratios, scores, discovery/search lists, expirations, rvol, per-contract bull/bear, the flow feed |
| Medium | 3 | charts, full chains, by-strike matrix, momentum/baseline/strikes, tide, aggregate, sweeps, market, sector, market-breadth, chain bull/bear, unusual-volume/oi screeners, dark-pool top-prints |
| Heavy | 5 | trade feeds (`/trades`, dark-pool trades), history (`/history`, `historical-compare`), bulk endpoints |

**Range-priced routes.** Where the range you ask for drives the work, the
tier price covers the first 30 days and each further 30 days (or part) is
charged again, so `interval=360D` on `/v1/market/tide` costs 3 × 12 = 36
credits. Range caps are enforced up front with a `400` (never charged):

| Route | Cap | Price |
|-------|-----|-------|
| `/v1/market/tide` | `interval` ≤ 30D with an intraday `bucket` (`1min`–`30min`), ≤ 360D with `1d`/`1w`; ≤ 5D with `exclude_deep_itm=true` | 3 × ⌈days ÷ 30⌉; with `exclude_deep_itm=true`, 3 per trading day |
| `/v1/underlying/{ticker}/chart`, `/v1/contract/{symbol}/chart` | `interval` ≤ 30D with an intraday `bucket`, ≤ 365D with `1d`/`1w` | 3 × ⌈days ÷ 30⌉ |
| `/v1/aggregate/{ticker}` | at most 8 `timeframes` | 3 × ⌈summed window days ÷ 30⌉ (`all` = 130 days = 15 credits) |
| `/v1/contract/top/daily` | — | 1 with `ticker`, 3 without (market-wide scan) |

`/v1/openapi.json` is free. When you run out of credits the API returns
`402` `insufficient_credits`; a suspended account returns `403`
`account_suspended`; a transient billing-store error returns `503`
`credit_check_failed` (safe to retry). These billing codes are lowercase
(`insufficient_credits`, `account_suspended`, `credit_check_failed`) — the
platform-wide convention for credit errors.

**Response envelope.** All success responses share one shape:

    { "data": <payload>, "meta": { "timestamp": "...", "requestId": "..." } }

All errors share one shape:

    { "error": { "code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "...",
                 "docs_url": "https://www.skylit.ai/docs/api-reference/errors#not_found" } }

`docs_url` (a link to the error's entry on the errors page) is optional:
read it when present, never require it. Retrying: `429` and `5xx` are
safe to retry with backoff (honor `Retry-After` when sent, otherwise wait
until `X-RateLimit-Reset` for a gateway `429`); other `4xx` need a changed
request. See https://www.skylit.ai/docs/api-reference/rate-limits-and-retries.

Field names are camelCase throughout. Codes are stable, machine-readable
`SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE` strings — the message text may evolve.

**Validation.** Requests are checked against this document before they
are charged:

- A parameter with a documented set of values (for example `timeframe`,
  `order_by`, `right`, `format`) must use one of them; anything else
  returns `400` `INVALID_PARAMETER` naming the allowed values. Date
  parameters must be `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- A ticker Skylit has never seen returns `404` `SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND`, whether
  it is in the path, the root of a contract symbol, or a `ticker` filter.
  For a list parameter (`tickers`, `symbols`) the request is served when
  at least one entry is known; unknown entries are simply absent from the
  result, and `404` is returned only when none is known. A known ticker
  with no activity in the window still returns `200` with empty data.
  Search (`/v1/underlying/search`) is not a lookup and returns `200 []`.
- List parameters accept at most 50 symbols; more returns `400`.
- Stay inside documented numeric ranges (`minimum`/`maximum`). Values
  outside a range are not rejected on every route today; where accepted
  they may be clamped (for example `limit` above its maximum) or ignored,
  so don't rely on out-of-range behaviour.
- A request that has not completed after 25 seconds returns `504`
  `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT`; narrow the window or retry.

None of these failures are charged.

**Freshness.** Endpoints with a `timeframe` parameter (e.g. `/v1/flow/{ticker}`)
return data through the last completed bucket. Intra-bucket fills land on the
next request. The cumulative `/v1/flow/market-breadth` and aggregate scoring
endpoints update at most once per second.
info.summary: Real-time and historical options-flow analytics as a public HTTP API.
info.title: Flowseeker — Skylit Public API

get.description:
Returns a Composite directional score plus its VWF / SDF / FIR
components for one or more trailing timeframes (intraday or
multi-day). Optional moneyness breakdown, optional time-decay
weighting, and a comparative trend block contrasting short- vs
long-horizon sentiment. Reference: PRD Section 8.

parameters.description:
Comma-separated timeframes, or `all`. Supported atoms:
`1h, 4h, 1d, 7d, 30d, 90d`. `all` expands to all six. Unknown
atoms are treated as a single trading day. At most 8 entries.
Priced by range: 3 credits per started 30 days of summed window
length (`1d,7d` = 3; `all` = 130 days = 15).
parameters.name: timeframes

parameters.description: Attach the per-timeframe VWF/SDF/FIR component split.
parameters.name: include_breakdown

parameters.description: Attach a `byMoneyness` array (deep_itm → deep_otm).
parameters.name: include_moneyness

parameters.description: Restrict to one expiration bucket.
parameters.name: expiration_filter

parameters.description: Apply exponential time decay to VWF / SDF / FIR components.
parameters.name: time_decay

parameters.description: Half-life in minutes for the decay (only applied when `timeDecay=true`).
parameters.name: time_decay_half_life

get.summary: Aggregate sentiment scoring across timeframes (VWF / SDF / FIR / Composite)

get.description:
Folds option type into the bid/ask/mid signal: a call lifted at the
ask is bullish, a put hit at the bid is also bullish (put selling),
etc. Returns overall bull/bear/neutral percentages plus call-only
and put-only bull breakdowns so callers can tell whether the
directional pressure originates from call buying, put selling, or
both.

Aggregates a ticker's full option chain to surface buying vs
selling pressure (`askRatio`, `bidRatio`, `midRatio`,
`aggressionRatio`), call/put balance, and ATM/OTM concentration.
Returns a `bias`, `aggression`, and `confidence` interpretation.
Reference: PRD Sections 12.3 and 14.

Single-contract counterpart to `/v1/chain-bull-bear/{ticker}`.
Maps a contract's trades to bull/bear/neutral buckets using both
side (bid/ask/mid) and option type, so a bullish put-seller and a
bullish call-buyer both register as bullish pressure.

Single-contract counterpart to `/v1/chain-ratio/{ticker}`. Returns
`askRatio`, `bidRatio`, `midRatio`, `aggressionRatio`, and a
`bias`/`aggression`/`confidence` interpretation for one specific
OPRA option symbol.

Returns a single-day `ContractStats` record per requested OPRA
symbol. Symbols absent from the response had no activity that day.

parameters.description: Comma-separated OPRA symbols (max 50).
parameters.name: symbols

get.summary: Bulk contract stats for a list of symbols

get.description:
Single-day top-contract screener with full-spectrum filters
(premium / volume / OI / IV / DTE / strike windows, call vs put,
sweep vs multi-leg). Sortable by `premium`, `volume`, `oi`, or `iv`.
Costs 1 credit with a `ticker` filter and 3 without one (the
market-wide scan).

parameters.description: Maximum rows to return. Server caps at 500.
parameters.name: limit

get.description:
Same shape as `/v1/contract/top/daily`, rolled up over the
trailing 5 trading days ending on `date`.

parameters.description: Maximum rows to return. Server caps at 500.
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Top contracts for the trailing week.

get.description:
Contracts whose open interest changed by at least
`min_oi_change` (or `min_oi_change_pct`) on the target date. `direction`
narrows the result to opening (OI ↑) or closing (OI ↓) flow.

parameters.description:
Target trading date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to the **previous
calendar day** (not the current trading date).
parameters.name: date

get.description:
Contracts whose volume on the target date is anomalously high
relative to a `avgPeriod`-day baseline. Filters cover RVOL, raw
volume, OI dynamics, premium, IV, moneyness, sweep / multi-leg,
and ticker include / exclude lists. Sortable by `rvol`, `volume`,
`premium`, `vol_oi`, or `oi_change`.

parameters.description: Baseline window as `{N}d`. Must be 2–365 days.
parameters.name: avg_period

parameters.description:
Target trading date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to the **previous
calendar day** (not the current trading date) since baselines
need a settled session.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Comma-separated tickers to exclude (e.g. `SPY,QQQ,IWM`).
parameters.name: exclude_tickers

200.description: Contracts ranked by the requested metric.

get.description:
Time-bucketed bars for a single contract — granular bid/mid/ask
execution split, premium and volume per side, daily cumulative
totals, VWAP, and (when available) IV and 30D average baselines.

parameters.description:
Trailing window — `{N}D` where N is 1–365 (e.g. `1D`, `7D`).
At most `30D` with an intraday bucket. Priced by range: 3 credits
per started 30 days.
parameters.name: interval

get.summary: Intraday chart bars for a contract

get.description:
Daily aggregates per trading day in `[startDate, endDate]` — total
premium / volume, OI dynamics, bid/ask execution split, sweep
and multi-leg shares, VWAP, last price, IV, and trade count.

Same shape as `/v1/underlying/{ticker}/rvol` but scoped to a
single contract.

parameters.description: Trailing window — `{N}D` where N is 1–365.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Baseline lookback as `{N}d` (e.g. `14d`). Max 365 days.
parameters.name: avg_period

parameters.description: Sort direction. Defaults to `asc` when `order_by=time`, otherwise `desc`.
parameters.name: order

200.description: RVOL bars + aggregate stats for the contract.
Stats for the contract on the requested date.

get.summary: Daily stats for a single contract

get.description:
Same enriched trade shape as `/v1/underlying/{ticker}/trades`,
scoped to a single OPRA contract. Because the contract is fixed,
chain-level filters (moneyness, strike, DTE, expiration) do not
apply here.

parameters.description: Lower time bound — RFC 3339 or Unix seconds. Defaults to start-of-trading-day.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Upper time bound — RFC 3339 or Unix seconds. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: end

get.summary: Raw enriched trades for a contract

get.description:
The top-N largest individual off-exchange prints for `{ticker}` over a
trailing window, ordered by notional descending. Each row is a single
TRF print (not an aggregate), useful as a support/resistance anchor.

parameters.description: Number of largest prints to return.
parameters.name: top_n

parameters.description: Calendar-day trailing window.
parameters.name: lookback_days

parameters.description:
Optional anchor date (`YYYY-MM-DD`); the window becomes
`[as_of_date - lookback_days, as_of_date]`. Omit for a today-anchored window.
parameters.name: as_of_date

200.description: Top-N largest prints for `{ticker}`, ordered by notional.

get.summary: Largest individual dark-pool prints for a ticker

get.description:
Server-side filtered dark-pool prints from the off-exchange tape
(FINRA TRF, publisher FINN/FINC). Defaults to **today (ET)** with a
**$1,000,000** minimum notional (the blocks-by-default rule); pass
`min_notional=0` for the full firehose. The trade-date span is capped
at **31 days** per request — page with `limit`/`offset` or narrow the
range for more. Prints carry **no side, BBO, or greeks**. Pagination
state (`limit`, `offset`, `count`, `hasMore`) is returned in `meta`.

call-put ratio against the trailing 20-trading-day average for the
same ticker. Returns absolute deltas, percentile rankings, and the
five most-similar past trading days.

parameters.description: Date to evaluate (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

trailing per-time-of-day baseline (`/v1/flow/{ticker}/baseline`).
Returns z-scores for the 5-minute window and a one-token `trend`
classification.

by selected ordering (premium, net premium, volume, etc.) with

a top-3 concentration summary.

get.description:
Bucketed bullish vs bearish premium time series for a single ticker,
with cumulative net premium and per-bucket VWF/SDF/FIR. The
ticker-level analogue of `/v1/market/tide`.

Returns market-wide call/put premium, total volume, directional
bullish/bearish premium, FIR, premium relative volume vs the
trailing 20-day baseline at the same time of day, and the top 10
tickers by total premium. Optionally narrowed to a comma-separated
ticker filter.

parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of tickers (e.g. `AAPL,NVDA,SPY`, max 50).
When omitted, returns true market-wide stats over every ticker.
parameters.name: tickers

get.summary: Market-wide flow overview for the current trading day

get.description:
Returns the market-wide intraday "tide" — bucketed Net Call
Premium and Net Put Premium series with both per-bucket and
cumulative values, plus an SPY price overlay for context. Two
directional flavors are emitted per bar: the standard `ncp`/`npp`
(call-buying minus call-selling, etc.) and a `manualNcp`/
`manualNpp` variant with the script-trade exclusion logic
relaxed for callers that need raw flow.

parameters.description:
Trailing window length. Defaults to a single trading day
(`1D`); multi-day intervals roll up history at the chosen
bucket size. Intraday buckets (`1min`–`30min`) allow at most
`30D`; use `1d` or `1w` for longer windows. Priced by range:
3 credits per started 30 days (`360D` = 36).
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Bucket size for the time series.
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.name: date

parameters.name: exclude_multi_leg

parameters.description:
Exclude deep in-the-money trades (`moneyness_percent < -20`) from
the directional totals. This reads raw trades rather than the
pre-aggregated series: `interval` is capped at `5D` and the call
costs 3 credits per trading day.
parameters.name: exclude_deep_itm

get.description:

deep_otm` buckets with premium, sentiment, percentage of total,
and trade count. Surfaces detected patterns (e.g. heavy OTM call
accumulation, ATM concentration, deep-OTM lottery tickets) and a
directional `signal`/`dominantStrategy` interpretation.

trade plus a spread-level breakdown and full trade context (ticker,
strike, expiration, sweep/block flags, moneyness). Used to drill
into a single row from `/v1/flow/{ticker}`.

The `trade_id` path parameter accepts three formats: the canonical
`flow_{hex}_{idx}` id returned by the flow feed, a bare hex
timestamp (`188afe42c3a77af2`), or a raw nanosecond integer.

grouped by contract within a one-second execution window. Each row
carries the venue list, total contracts/premium, spread position,
moneyness bucket, and Skylit Flow Score / FlowBonus. The summary
block adds population-level Sweep Dominance Factor (SDF) and
bullish/bearish counts extrapolated from the full-day total.

a one-token signal (`strong_accumulation` → `low_activity`).
